credit_100.prompt: A single bright metallic credit token ping sweeps past a spaceship cockpit, crisp airy tail.

credit_200.prompt: Two quick silver coin pings ascending, with a light passing swish.

credit_350.prompt: Three bright crystalline coin clinks stepping upward, short Doppler shimmer.

credit_500.prompt: A handful of gold tokens clinks in a quick ascending sparkle, soft rushing air.

credit_1000.prompt: An exceptional arcade jackpot, rapid cascade of high glassy token chimes ending on one ringing bell.

salvage_mineral.prompt: A gemstone clinks into a magnetic metal cargo cradle, followed by a delicate crystalline ring.

salvage_nutrient.prompt: A soft gelatinous alien nutrient pod plops into a suction canister and the seal clicks.

supply_shield.prompt: A soft rising electric ripple gathers into one clear resonant shield recharge ping.

supply_ordnance.prompt: Two chunky metal ammunition cartridges slide into a breech with a double mechanical clack.

supply_flare.prompt: A small countermeasure canister slides into a spring cassette with a sharp light snap.

supply_full.prompt: A restrained low double hollow knock from a full cargo bay indicator.

patrol_gate.prompt: A fast airy ring passing overhead with a brief bright electronic timing tick.

patrol_rescue.prompt: A pneumatic rescue pod hatch closes, then one warm safety beacon chirp.

patrol_freight.prompt: A heavy freight grapple catches a crate, chunky ratchet and mechanical lock.

patrol_survey.prompt: A short high scanning sweep resolves into a glassy data confirmation trill.

patrol_repair.prompt: A compact repair tool buzzes against a hull plate and clicks tight.

patrol_coolant.prompt: A pressure valve opens with a brisk hiss of coolant flowing through a pipe and shuts.

patrol_restart.prompt: The sound of a starter motor turning over. A brief electrical crackle, a low rising motor whir, then the engine catches.

patrol_complete.prompt: Three clean cockpit confirmation tones climb and settle into a gentle resonant chord.

patrol_failed.prompt: Two muted descending amber cockpit warning tones with a short dry tail.

tractor_lock.prompt: A magnetic tractor pickup catches with a rising resonant hum and a gentle snap.

gun_pulse.prompt: A single tight, bright sci fi pulse cannon zap, instant attack with a short descending tail.

gun_quad.prompt: One volley of four close spaced plasma pops from paired spacecraft cannons, hot and punchy.

gun_tachyon.prompt: A piercing narrow energy beam streak with a dense electrical buzz, quick taper.

secondary_concussion.prompt: A heavy torpedo kicks out of a ship tube with a clunk and a receding rocket rush.

secondary_swarm.prompt: Three small guided rockets spit in rapid succession and whistle away.

secondary_emp.prompt: A capacitor discharges with a low electric thump and an expanding rippling electromagnetic wave.

flare_deploy.prompt: A countermeasure dispenser rattles off a cluster of flares, sharp pops and sparkling fizz.

enemy_laser.prompt: A distant hostile interceptor laser snaps past with a thin nasal descending whine.

enemy_missile.prompt: A distant missile motor ignites with a bark and fades into a short receding hiss.

enemy_bioshot.prompt: An alien creature spits a pressurized spore missile, wet pop and whistling tail.

missile_deflect.prompt: A fast projectile glances off an energy shield with a bright ricochet and Doppler whistle.

hull_impact.prompt: A blunt impact shakes a metal cockpit panel, muted bass thud with a brief rattle.

shield_hit.prompt: A short plucked electrical membrane ripple as a spacecraft shield absorbs an impact.

shield_empty.prompt: A sputtering electric shield collapses down in pitch with two short warning pulses.

shield_regen.prompt: A quiet rising electrical shimmer as a deflector field reconnects.

shield_surge.prompt: A powerful upward cascade of capacitor energy swells into a clear shield resonance.

shield_block.prompt: An incoming shot bounces off an armored energy barrier with a sharp hollow metallic zing.

vent_overheat.prompt: A hot gun cooling vent bursts open with a sharp pressurized steam hiss.

vent_ready.prompt: A cooling vent latch snaps shut with a short high ready chirp.

evade_shift.prompt: A single lateral maneuvering thruster blasts to one side, fast air pressure whoosh.

barrel_roll.prompt: Two maneuvering thrusters fire in succession in a rising then falling corkscrew swoosh.

avionics_switch.prompt: A compact cockpit relay switches with a tactile click and a soft electronic blip.

systems_denied.prompt: Two short dry low electronic buzzes from a cockpit interlock.

radar_ping.prompt: One clear sonar-like radar range ping, bright attack with a short fading echo.

hazard_alert.prompt: A concise alternating pair of cockpit hazard beeps, gently urgent.

frost_contact.prompt: A sudden frosty crackle spreads across a glass canopy in tiny brittle ice crystals.

acid_contact.prompt: Liquid acid spatters against metal and sizzles away sharply.

spore_static.prompt: A burst of gritty radio static stutters and fades as spores obscure a radar receiver.

tripwire_contact.prompt: A taut electrical laser wire lashes across a hull with a sizzling snap.

thermal_charge.prompt: A hostile heat projector winds up with a rising furnace hum and electric whine.

thermal_contact.prompt: A hot energy sheet washes over a metal hull with a brief fierce hiss.

volatile_ignite.prompt: A rock core begins an unstable chain reaction, brittle crack followed by fast sizzling.

boss_collapse.prompt: A huge armored vessel buckles with a deep tearing metallic groan and cascading distant booms.

tower_fracture.prompt: A heavy support tower shears with a low crack, rattling falling debris.

tracking_jam.prompt: A radar signal scrambles into descending digital chatter and then abruptly cuts out.

cloak_engage.prompt: An electronic cloaking field shimmers, pitches down and vanishes into silence.

streak_gain.prompt: A short triumphant ascending sequence of bright cockpit score tones.

streak_lost.prompt: A scored combo falls away in three muted descending tones.

ejection.prompt: Explosive canopy bolts pop and an escape capsule rockets clear with a forceful air rush.

boss_breach.prompt: A massive armored core unlocks with a metallic double clunk and a clear high targeting tone.

hull_critical.prompt: Three urgent low, dry electronic warning pulses from a damaged cockpit.

ice_landing.prompt: A great chunk of ice slams into frozen ground with a brittle crash and scattering crystalline splinters.

ruin_landing.prompt: A stone slab breaks loose and crashes into a sandy canyon floor, dry crunch and rolling grit.

vent_eruption.prompt: A volcanic steam vent blasts upward, a deep pressure pop giving way to rushing hot gas.

rock_flyby.prompt: A fast tumbling boulder streaks across the pilot's path with a low Doppler whirr and gravelly rattle.

drone_launch.prompt: An armored carrier bay releases two scout drones, a hydraulic clack and two short receding motor whines.

web_cast.prompt: An electric tripwire lattice unfurls in a fast sweep of tight sizzling filaments.

thermal_discharge.prompt: An industrial heat weapon fires a broad sustained sweep of searing energy with a hard attack.

claw_release.prompt: A giant claw slips off a metal fuselage, scraping talons followed by the rush of the craft being thrown.

torpedo_burst.prompt: A compact explosive projectile strikes a surface with a sharp crack and short bassy expanding boom.

rescue_mold.prompt: An industrial steel casting mold slides onto a foundry tug with a deep clunk and the transport clamps lock shut.

rescue_converter.prompt: A power plug clicks loudly into a socket. The click is followed immediately by a brief low electrical buzz and a single clean test beep.

rescue_reeds.prompt: A pallet of wet leafy reeds slides aboard a small ship, soft rustling leaves, dripping water and a single wooden thump.

rescue_tow.prompt: A towing hook catches with a hefty metallic clank, the wire cable twangs under tension and settles.

rescue_relay.prompt: A hardwired flight data cartridge disengages with a crisp little mechanical click and a rapid three-pip transfer confirmation.
